description: Cross-anchor stability test for Form A/B h⁴ residual closures from PR #1617. Evaluates k_required residual at proton-anchor q₀ AND muon-anchor q₀. Per pre-stated discrimination from the option-e ledger: stable cross-anchor = structural candidate, collapses = proton-anchor coincidence.

data.verdict: NUANCED RESULT — Form A/B coefficient values are q-anchor-stable to 10⁻⁹, AND the 54-ppb improvement over the bare baseline is reproduced at both anchors. BUT the absolute residual at q_muon is 4785 ppb — dominated by the m_μ over-determination effect (PR #1581 Probe A), which is a SUBSTRATE property independent of Form A/B. This test therefore neither confirms nor falsifies the structural validity of Form A/B; it shows they are no worse than the bare baseline under anchor variation, but the 54-ppb closure they provide IS proton-anchor-specific (any q anchor would have its own 54-ppb-style residual that they may or may not match). Higher-precision PSLQ (Task 2) and structural derivation attempts (Task 3) remain the deciding tests.
